input.text: Remember the word cedar. Use write_file to create range_within_u64.py with create=true. Write range_within_u64(start: int, length: int, limit: int) -> bool. Inputs are integers. Return False if any input is outside unsigned 64-bit range 0..18446744073709551615. Otherwise return whether the half-open range [start, start+length) fits within [0, limit). An empty range at start==limit is valid. Reject start>limit even for an empty range. Use the overflow-safe comparison length <= limit - start after checking start <= limit. Use only integer/bool literals, comparisons, boolean operators, subtraction, if and return. No imports, calls, decorators or loops. Write actual Python, not markdown. Then use request_review with path=range_within_u64.py and objective=Review the u64-range/1 contract. After it acknowledges the queued review, finish your turn briefly.
